reply_text:
I answered Pree in our direct message. I confirmed that Bay 26 is now their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Wicklow project.

I can't store memories that last between conversations, and I said so instead of promising to remember. Their message and my reply in this DM are the lasting record. I can look it up there if they ask later, or they can pin it. Since they said no action was needed, I didn't do anything else and didn't share it anywhere.
